measurementLimits: requestAnimationFrame measures browser callback cadence, not Unity rendered FPS. audio.method: A zero-gain analyser side branch observes nodes connected to the normal AudioContext destination. Original output connections remain intact. No resume call or autoplay-policy override is used. RMS samples are graph-level mono windows, not an audio recording or a listening test.
